question: In Mark 16:14, why did Jesus rebuke the eleven when he appeared to them?
options: For their lack of faith and refusal to believe those who had seen him
explanation: Verse 14 says Jesus rebuked them for their lack of faith and their stubborn refusal to believe those who had seen him after he had risen. (Mark 16:9-20 is not found in the earliest manuscripts, as the NIV notes.)
